Follow-up tests changed rejected sibling tokens while holding batching/tree structure fixed and obtained identical surviving full and recurrent hashes.

cause_limit: The failed continuation mechanisms were not conclusively attributed to a particular kernel or state component. No confirmed dependence of the surviving state on rejected sibling token values was found in the controlled branch tests.
